derivation.behavior: Backend migration fences source backend and transfers authority through a new generation.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go quiesces/fences source, reserves target generation/ownership, activates target, then retires source.

invariants: Migration reserves a fresh attempt generation before any target activation, which immediately fences the source from canonical writes.
The source is quiesced and inspected before target establishment; checkpoint reuse is explicit rather than inferred from a path.
The target establishes durable non-writing ownership before activation and the source is retired only after target activation is durable.
Every durable boundary and every external-effect-before-commit boundary is idempotently recoverable.
Late source progress or completion after generation transfer is diagnostic only.
